subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Graded readers 1 and 2: The Desert Safari / The Nature Hunt
outcomes: Follow the main events of The Desert Safari and The Nature Hunt.
Name the animals in the stories and what they do.
Use must, might and the first conditional from the stories.

tf.s: Khalid and his family ride on the back of a big truck.
tf.why: Yes, they go on a desert safari in a truck.

tf.s: In The Desert Safari, the eagle catches a fish.
The gazelles use their long horns to fight with.
Khalid's family see an Arabian leopard on the safari.
tf.why: Yes, the leopard is the most exciting part.

tf.s: In The Nature Hunt, the flamingos have antennae.
tf.why: The beetle has antennae; flamingos lay eggs.

tf.s: In The Nature Hunt, the girls find the hedgehog in the lake.
tf.why: They find it in the trees.

tf.s: The flamingos are the animals that lay eggs in The Nature Hunt.
The girls find a beetle on the bus window at the end.
The girls don't win the prize.
tf.why: They win because they find all the animals.

tf.s: The hedgehog curls up when Noora takes a photo.
tf.why: Yes, it makes itself into a ball.

boxes.q: What does the eagle catch in The Desert Safari?
What does the Arabian leopard have?
boxes.why: That is how the story describes it.

boxes.q: Why does Khalid's mum look worried?
o: The leopard runs to the truck, roaring.
boxes.why: A roaring leopard coming close is scary.

boxes.q: Where do the girls find fish with fins and scales?
Who takes the photo of the hedgehog?

boxes.why: Hedgehogs have spines on their back.

o: a game where you look for animals outside
a ride on a truck in the desert
boxes.why: In a nature hunt you find animals from a list.

boxes.q: Complete: If you find all the animals, you ___ win a prize.
Khalid is sure. It ___ be looking for food.
Which is a big hill of sand?
boxes.why: Sand dunes are in the desert.

mcq.q: What do the girls need to find in The Nature Hunt?
o: animals with antennae, spines, scales and fins, and one that lays eggs
a leopard, an eagle and a gazelle
mcq.why: That is the list for the nature hunt.

mcq.q: Which four animals does Khalid's family see on the desert safari?
o: an eagle, gazelles, a scorpion and a leopard
a hedgehog, a beetle, fish and flamingos
a lion, a shark, a bee and a turtle
a camel, a horse, a goat and a cat

mcq.q: How does The Desert Safari end?
o: The leopard catches the meat and runs away.
The leopard gets into the truck.
The family gets lost in the desert.
mcq.why: The guide's meat keeps everyone safe.

mcq.q: Why do the girls win the prize?
o: They found all the animals on the list.

mcq.q: Which is the guide's sentence with if?
o: If you look over there, you'll see an Arabian leopard!
If you will look over there, you see an Arabian leopard!
If you looked over there, you'll see an Arabian leopard!
If you look over there, you saw an Arabian leopard!

mcq.q: Make a new If sentence for a nature hunt.
o: If we look under the rocks, we'll find a beetle.
If we will look under the rocks, we find a beetle.
If we looking under the rocks, we'll find a beetle.
If we look under the rocks, we found a beetle.

mcq.q: The guide says: They could be Arabian gazelles. How sure is he?
mcq.why: Could shows a possibility, not certainty.

mcq.q: Why does the family leave the scorpion quickly?
o: If it stings you, you'll need to go to hospital.
It is too small to see.
The truck is out of fuel.

mcq.q: Why does Sabah think the hunt might be difficult?
o: They need to find four different kinds of animals.
Animals are not allowed in the park.
mcq.why: Finding four kinds of animals is a big job.

mcq.q: Which item on the list does the beetle complete?
o: an animal with scales and fins
